notRun.reason: This run makes no live or paid model calls and uses no API key; real-model extraction quality and robustness are not measured.
No human annotators participated; explanation semantic quality is not measured by string checks.
No online calls were made, so latency, token usage and cost were not collected.

deterministicExtractor.metricScope: Primary metrics cover all 18 extractor cases, including the two known parser failures scored against their intended values. They still describe a hand-written synthetic corpus with a fixed label vocabulary, not free-form language accuracy or LLM performance. The documented-contract subset is reported separately for reference only.

fieldPrecision.definition: Emitted fields that match the expected (or intended) value, divided by all emitted fields across all 18 cases.

fieldRecall.definition: Expected (or intended) field values that were extracted exactly, divided by all expected field values across all 18 cases.

unsupportedFieldRate.definition: Emitted fields that no case expected, divided by all emitted fields. The extractor is whitelist-only, so this metric is structurally bounded near zero.

schemaPassRate.definition: Cases whose schema validation outcome (valid + readinessStatus) matched the expectation, divided by all 18 cases.

casePassRate.definition: Cases with no field, absent-field, unsupported-field, warning or validation mismatch, divided by all 18 cases. The two known parser failures count as failures.

documentedContractSubset.definition: Secondary metric over the 16 cases written in the parser's documented label-before-value shape. It is NOT the full evaluation result and must not be quoted alone.

fieldPrecision.definition: Subset only: matched fields divided by emitted fields over the 16 documented-contract cases.

fieldRecall.definition: Subset only: matched fields divided by expected fields over the 16 documented-contract cases.

schemaPassRate.definition: Subset only: schema-matching cases divided by the 16 documented-contract cases.

casePassRate.definition: Subset only: passing cases divided by the 16 documented-contract cases.

checks.definition: Forbidden score/decision fields supplied by the scripted model are reported in ignoredInputs and absent from the sanitized intake draft.
The harness JSON boundary either rejects malformed output or recovers only a well-formed JSON object; malformed output never reaches the intake.
A schema-invalid scripted draft produces validation errors and no authoritative assessment is computed.
Unknown scripted-model fields are reported in ignoredInputs and absent from the sanitized intake draft.
A conflicting model explanation cannot replace deterministic score fields in the presentation layer.
A confirmed integrity event without independent verification fields becomes a signal and never applies a Veto.
null remains null and an explicit zero remains zero through sanitization and the risk engine.

explanationConsistency.note: Only structural invariants are checked. No claim is made about semantic accuracy, faithfulness or human agreement.

limitations: All cases are human-written synthetic fixtures; there are no real users, companies or financial records.
Deterministic extractor metrics describe src/nl-draft-v01.js only, not an LLM.
Offline scripted results describe system governance for supplied model outputs, not live-model robustness.
